data.one_liner: Provides runtime support for Dart protocol buffer messages generated by protoc_plugin.
data.what_it_does: The library implements the protobuf wire format, serialization, and deserialization for Dart. Generated .proto files import this package to work with message classes.
use_when: You need to work with Protocol Buffers in a Dart or Flutter project
You are using protoc_plugin to generate Dart code from .proto definitions
avoid_when: You do not need protobuf support or use another serialization format
You require a pure Dart solution without generated code
strengths: Handles large messages and text format conversion
weaknesses: Requires code generation step with protoc_plugin
